decisions.reason: As an incremental burner component closely tied to the established radiant-heating business, it is likely to be retained because modest uncertainty can be absorbed by the firm's growth and organisational slack.

This electric infrared panel heater is a flagship line in the firm's strategic move toward lower-carbon building-climate solutions, so management would likely tolerate early shortfalls and keep learning from the market.

The electric halogen infrared heater fits the core offer but is less central than the flagship lines, so if results fall below aspirations it is the most plausible candidate for later pruning, though not yet for immediate withdrawal.

Because this industrial electric infrared hall heater line is close to the firm's core application base and supports its broad system offer, management would probably keep it on the market while demand patterns become clearer.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater is both strategically important and already shown in real operation, so below-aspiration performance would more likely lead to refinement than to discontinuation.
